description: This file defines client-side API utilities for interacting with a backend server, including functions for obtaining the base URL, making authenticated API requests, performing health checks, and a mock login function.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the backend base URL, either from environment variables or a default local address.

methods.name: parseJsonSafe(res)
methods.description: Safely parses the response text as JSON, falling back to raw text if parsing fails.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {})
methods.description: Performs an API request with proper headers, handling JSON encoding, authentication, and error processing.

methods.name: healthCheck()
methods.description: Checks backend health by requesting the root endpoint.

methods.name: loginMock({ email })
methods.description: Provides a mock login response for demo purposes.

ctags.name: apiRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {}) {$/
